name: VHS rewind transition
description: A tape-rewind transition laid over the picture for about a second: the frame dims, white VHS tracking bars and thin cyan and magenta streaks race up the frame, a big double-triangle rewind symbol and 'REWIND' flash in the middle with a running backwards timecode, and an orange pill names where we jump to ('1 WEEK AGO'); it clears the moment the story restarts.
use_when: Right after a cold open or flash-forward, to jump back to the start of the story ('let me rewind', 'a week ago', 'it all started when'); centre it on the cut.

label.help: where the story jumps to, e.g. '1 WEEK AGO'; empty for none

text.help: the big word beside the symbol
